answer: Keeping 64 aliases alive as a result means 64 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the hollow quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the onyx log shows the live set and the echo audit records each lapse. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 70 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 6 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
